title: Baat bu noppi ci biir néeg bi
intro: Benn ñaan bu amoon ci biir néeg bu sell bu yàgg, jog ci ruuh bu màgget, bëgg lu àdduna bi waxoon ni mënul am. Nit ki màgget lool, jaaxle lool ci ëlëg, mu wëlbatiku ci seen Boroom, di ñaanal seen boroom. Li ci topp mooy tontub Yàlla bu dëppoo ak lépp lu nit ñi mëna seentu—muy firndeel yërmaandeg Kiy tontu woote bu amul benn yaakaar.
clues: Ma woo sama Boroom ci sama bopp, ma dem ci néeg bi ma jaamu ko.
Ma nangu sama Boroom ni dama ragal ñiy ñëw ci sama ginaaw, maa ngi jaaxle ci njiitu sama askan su ma demee.
Màgget daal di jàpp sama yaram—samay yax dañu tàmbali néew doole, kawar gu weex tasaaroo ci sama bopp.
Sama jabar amul doom ci dundam yépp, waaye ba leegi maa ngi ñaan sama Boroom mu may ma ndono ci kanamam.
Ma ñaan firnde, sama Boroom tontu ma, mu tere ma wax ak kenn ci diiru ñatti guddi, fekk maa ngi wér ci sama yaram.
Digoon nañu ma doom bu góor bu tuddu Yahya, tur wi sama Boroom wax ni kenn musu ko jox ci àdduna.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
